descricao: Understand the process as it actually happens before automating or changing any technology.
Separate symptom, likely cause and evidence, so decisions do not rest on perception alone.
Map dependencies and risks before any change.
Prefer small changes, with a backup and a way back, in critical environments.
Automate what is repetitive and keep human validation wherever the risk calls for it.
Define metrics and criteria to confirm, with data, whether the solution worked.
Document so that someone else can operate, audit or continue the work.
Turn incidents and one-off tasks into permanent improvements whenever possible.
